name: 55009 · Cannon Falls, MN
findings: ZIP 55009 (Cannon Falls) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55009 (Cannon Falls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55009 (Cannon Falls) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
